title: Speaking Practice 10 - Reading Habits
description: IELTS Speaking Part 1: Questions about reading preferences and habits.

stimuli.title: Part 1: Reading Habits
stimuli.content: Answer questions about your reading preferences.

questionGroups.instruction: Answer the following questions about reading.

explanation.sampleAnswer: Yes, I'm quite an avid reader. I try to read at least one book a month, though sometimes I manage more during holidays.

questions.content: What kind of books do you prefer?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I mostly enjoy non-fiction books about psychology and self-improvement. I also love historical fiction.

questions.content: Do you read more now than when you were younger?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Actually, I think I read less now because of social media and university workload. But I try to set aside time before bed for reading.

questions.content: Do you prefer paper books or e-books?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I prefer paper books for the tactile experience, but I use e-books when traveling because they're more practical.

questions.content: Do you think reading is important for children?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Absolutely. Reading develops vocabulary, imagination, and critical thinking skills from a young age.
